subject: Security discovery & retention scope — next steps and evidence timeline
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@luminex.com>, Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@luminex.com>, security@luminex.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Aug 2027 13:02:00 -0700
Subject: Security discovery & retention scope — next steps and evidence timeline

Hi Elena / Liam — thanks again for the time today. Short recap of what we captured on the call and proposed next steps so we can keep momentum: 

Summary of pain & goals
- Pain: inconsistent audit log access across your current vendors; need 90+ day immutable audit logs for payments investigation and regulators.
- Goal: validate Redwood's retention and access controls, confirm whether our SOC 2 scope covers payment-processing endpoints, and establish a path to acceptance (DPA + pen test window).

What we agreed / clarifications we need
- Redwood provides audit log retention by default for 90 days; extended retention and long-term archive can be configured per customer. I'll confirm retention SLA and export formats with our infra team and share exact log types (api, auth, admin).
- SOC 2: we'll provide our SOC 2 Type II summary report and a scoped controls matrix showing which control families cover payment-related flows. See attached high-level summary.
- Pen test: you prefer a vendor-run pen test vs. blackbox scheduling — good to confirm acceptable test window (you mentioned Oct).
- DPA: we understand you'll share a redline (legal contact in the thread). Please indicate whether the redline includes retention clauses you want changed.

Attachments included
- redwood-soc2-summary.pdf (high-level SOC 2 Type II scope + control matrix)
- evidence-intake-template.xlsx (spreadsheet to map your artifact asks to our artifacts / owners)

Immediate next steps (proposed)
1) Karthik: confirm exact audit log types, retention export formats, and SLA by Thu 2027-09-02.
2) Elena / Liam: share your DPA redline and name primary legal/security point of contact (if not security@luminex.com) by Fri 2027-09-03.
3) Marissa: prepare artifact mapping from our side using the attached intake template; first pass by Mon 2027-09-06.
4) Neha: coordinate with infra/legal on pen test windows and provide proposed dates in Oct.

Where to upload evidence
- Preferred: shared Drive folder (link below) or secure intake portal (https://app.redwood.ai/intake/LXN-1147). If you need SFTP, we can open that as well.

Proposed follow-up
- Quick sync to review artifact mapping: Tue 2027-09-07 10:00 BST — please confirm if that works for your team.

If anything above is off, flag and I will update. Otherwise we can treat this as our action plan and track in the shared Drive + intake portal.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
---
Attachment stubs: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf (PDF, 4 pages); evidence-intake-template.xlsx (Excel, 1 sheet)

From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@luminex.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@luminex.com>, security@luminex.com, Marcus Li <marcus.li@luminex.com>
Date: Tue, 31 Aug 2027 09:10:00 +01:00
Subject: Re: Security discovery & retention scope — next steps and evidence timeline

Karthik — thanks for the concise recap. A few clarifications and confirmations from our side: 

1) Retention: we require 90 days of immutable audit logs as a baseline; for certain regulated flows we need 1 year of accessible logs and 7 years of archived records. Can you confirm Redwood supports configurable retention to those durations and whether the archive is immutable? Also, what is the process and lead time for enabling extended retention per account?

2) SOC 2: the SOC 2 summary is helpful — can you include the date range covered by the report and confirm whether production payment-processing endpoints are in scope or excluded? We need the Type II report or the SOC letter that references the audit period.

3) Pen test: yes, Oct is our preferred month for vendor tests. We'll need a statement of methods and a point of contact for coordination. Marcus Li (security) will own coordination internally — looping him here.

4) DPA: attached is our redline (Luminex_DPA_redline_v3.docx). Legal will expect you to review and indicate which retention clauses are non-starters. If possible, provide a single consolidated answer doc instead of line-by-line comments — that speeds our review.

5) Evidence ingestion: Drive link is fine for now (we have internal TPRMs that may request SFTP later). Please upload the SOC 2 Type II file to the Drive folder and share any artifact mapping by next Tue.

Accepting your proposed sync on Tue 2027-09-07 10:00 BST.

Elena Rossi
Head of Compliance
Luminex Payments
---
Attachment stub: Luminex_DPA_redline_v3.docx (Word, redline)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 01 Sep 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Security discovery & retention scope — next steps and evidence timeline (internal)

Marissa / Neha — forwarding Elena's reply. Key asks to handle: 

- Marissa: please start populating the evidence-intake-template with owners for the items Elena flagged (SOC 2 Type II, audit log export formats, retention archive details). Aim for a first pass by EOD Mon 2027-09-06. I'll upload the redwood-soc2-type2.pdf to the shared Drive once legal confirms we can share the full report (likely today).
- Neha: assign an infra SME to confirm immutable archive options and lead time to enable 1 year and 7 year retention paths. Also please draft a short statement on audit log export formats (json/csv/syslog) and how we deliver them.
- Legal coordination: I will review Luminex_DPA_redline_v3 and flag retention clauses that conflict with product defaults; if we need exceptions we'll document them and propose alternate language.

Notes for the sync on 2027-09-07: we should have (1) SOC 2 report or confirmation of date range, (2) intake template populated with owners and sample artifacts, (3) initial answer doc for DPA redline (high level).

I'll keep Elena / Luminex in the loop (copying them when we have the SOC 2 Type II ready).

Thanks,
Karthik
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
